ambient_events: A shower head somewhere down the row coughs, spits, and gives up.
Water finds the trench drain and goes down it in a long, unhurried gulp.
The extractor fan changes pitch for no reason and then changes back.
Somewhere above, a boot scuffs concrete and stops directly overhead.
description: One open room with no doors on anything and a trench drain down the floor. Six shower heads on one pipe, four working, all on the same municipal timer. The tiles have gone the colour of a bad tooth, the grout black. A sheet of polished steel stands in for a mirror. Everything is visible from the doorway. The cell block is back west.
name: Wash Block
